headline: OAK @ SFG matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is OAK 4.38 at SFG 5.84, with a projected total of 10.23. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SFG: OAK moved -0.33 runs while SFG moved +0.48, changing the projected margin by -0.81 runs. NRFI probability dropped -13.0%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Robbie Ray has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Zack Gelof, Nick Kurtz, Luis Arraez, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Carlos Cortes, Colby Thomas because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
